mnemonic.meaning: 強 is strong: you make it stronger. To strengthen, intensify.
mnemonic.reading: TSU, YO, MEh-RUE (つよめる): "Sue, yo, make the coffee stronger."

examples.ja: 警察は警備を強めた。
examples.en: The police tightened security.

items.note: Transitive (you strengthen it). 強まる = it gets stronger.

mnemonic.meaning: A faint (微) laugh (笑): just a small smile.
mnemonic.reading: HO HO, AIM (ほほえむ): Santa aims a gentle smile at you.

examples.ja: 彼女は優しく微笑んだ。
examples.en: She smiled gently.

items.note: A quiet smile, not a laugh (笑う). 微笑み = a smile.

mnemonic.meaning: The evil (悪) demon (魔). The devil.
mnemonic.reading: AH, COO, MA (あくま)! The devil whispers to your ma.

examples.ja: 彼は悪魔のような笑顔を見せた。
examples.en: He gave a devilish grin.

items.note: 天使 (てんし) = angel is the opposite.

mnemonic.meaning: 脇 has 月 (flesh) and three 力 (power) arms: the side of your body, under the arm. The armpit.
mnemonic.reading: WACKY (わき): the wacky guy tickles your armpit from the side.

examples.ja: 本を脇に抱えて歩いた。
examples.en: I walked with a book under my arm.

items.note: Also "beside": 道の脇 (the side of the road). 脇役 = supporting role.

mnemonic.meaning: 盾 has 目 (eye) behind a wall: you peek out from behind your shield.
mnemonic.reading: TA-TAY (たて): "Take that!" you shout, blocking with your shield.

examples.ja: 兵士は盾で身を守った。
examples.en: The soldier protected himself with a shield.

items.note: Figurative: 〜を盾にする = to use something as a shield.

mnemonic.meaning: Possible (可) to love (愛): so lovable it's cute. Lovely, sweet.
mnemonic.reading: KAWAII, RASHII (かわいらしい): it seems (らしい) cute (かわいい). Lovely!

examples.ja: 可愛らしい人形が飾ってある。
examples.en: A lovely doll is on display.

items.note: Softer and more descriptive than かわいい.

mnemonic.meaning: 翼 has 羽 (feathers) on top: feathers spreading wide. A wing.
mnemonic.reading: TSU, BASSA (つばさ): the bird flaps its wings: BASSA BASSA!

examples.ja: 鳥が大きな翼を広げた。
examples.en: The bird spread its large wings.

items.note: Also airplane wings. 羽 (はね) is a feather or small wing.

mnemonic.meaning: The edge (端) of the route (途): the exact moment you reach it. Just as.
mnemonic.reading: TOE TAN (とたん): the moment you step outside, your toes get a tan.

examples.ja: 家を出た途端、雨が降り出した。
examples.en: The moment I left the house, it started raining.

items.note: Used as V-た + 途端(に). The second event is unexpected.

mnemonic.meaning: 問 has 口 (mouth) in a 門 (gate): someone at the gate calls out a question.
mnemonic.reading: TOY (とい): the kid holds up a toy and asks a question.

examples.ja: 次の問いに答えなさい。
examples.en: Answer the following question.

items.note: Formal / written; 質問 is everyday. Common on exam papers.

mnemonic.meaning: SUN, ah, WATCH EE (すなわち): the sun, in other words, is a big watch. Namely, it tells time.

examples.ja: 彼は母の弟、すなわち私の叔父だ。
examples.en: He is my mother's younger brother, that is, my uncle.

items.note: Formal and written. つまり is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Joyful (歓) voices (声). A cheer, shouts of joy.
mnemonic.reading: CAN SAY (かんせい): the crowd can say only one thing: a huge cheer!

examples.ja: ゴールが決まると、歓声が上がった。
examples.en: When the goal went in, a cheer went up.

items.note: 歓声を上げる = to cheer.

mnemonic.meaning: The moment carved (刻) into time (時). The time, the hour.
mnemonic.reading: GEE, COKE (じこく): "Gee, it's time for Coke!"

examples.ja: 電車の時刻を調べた。
examples.en: I checked the train times.

items.note: A specific point in time. 時間 is an amount of time. 時刻表 = timetable.

mnemonic.meaning: 霧 has 雨 (rain) on top: rain so fine it hangs in the air. Fog, mist.
mnemonic.reading: KEY, REE (きり): you can't find your key in the thick fog.

examples.ja: 朝は霧で何も見えなかった。
examples.en: I couldn't see anything in the morning fog.

items.note: 霧が出る = fog comes up. 霧雨 = drizzle.

mnemonic.meaning: Express (表) and show (示). A display, a label.
mnemonic.reading: HYO, GEE (ひょうじ): "Hyo, gee, look at the display!"

examples.ja: 画面にエラーが表示された。
examples.en: An error appeared on the screen.

items.note: Also on labels: 値段の表示 (price label).

mnemonic.meaning: 嵐 is 山 (mountain) over 風 (wind): wind roaring over the mountain. A storm.
mnemonic.reading: AH, RASH, EE (あらし): the storm leaves you with a rash. Eee!

examples.ja: 昨夜はひどい嵐だった。
examples.en: Last night there was a terrible storm.

items.note: Figurative: 拍手の嵐 (storm of applause).

mnemonic.meaning: Seize (拘) and bind (束). Restraint, detention.
mnemonic.reading: COAT SOCK (こうそく): they bind you with a coat and a sock. Restraint!

examples.ja: 容疑者は警察に拘束された。
examples.en: The suspect was detained by the police.

items.note: Also "tie down" by work: 拘束時間 (hours you're bound to work).

mnemonic.meaning: Two hair kanji: 髪 (hair on the head) + 毛 (fur). The hair on your head.
mnemonic.reading: KAMI NO KE (かみのけ): "The hair of the god (神)". Your glorious head of hair.

examples.ja: 髪の毛が長くなった。
examples.en: My hair has gotten long.

items.note: Same as 髪 but more everyday; also for a single strand.

mnemonic.meaning: Your old (故) village (郷). Your hometown.
mnemonic.reading: COKE, YO (こきょう): "Coke, yo, tastes better in my hometown."

examples.ja: 夏休みに故郷に帰った。
examples.en: I went back to my hometown for the summer holidays.

items.note: ふるさと is softer and more poetic. 地元 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 裸 has 衤 (clothes) on the left, but the clothes are gone. Naked.
mnemonic.reading: HA, DA, CAR (はだか)! Ha, da guy's car is in the street, and he's naked!

examples.ja: 子供が裸で走り回っている。
examples.en: A child is running around naked.

items.note: 裸足 (はだし) = barefoot.

mnemonic.meaning: "NAZE (why)? NARA (なぜなら)!" Because the reason is Nara, with its deer.

examples.ja: 今日は休みます。なぜなら、熱があるからです。
examples.en: I'm taking today off. The reason is that I have a fever.

items.note: Usually なぜなら〜からだ. Formal; in speech people just say 〜から.

mnemonic.meaning: Wait for (候) a supplement (補) to fill the post. A candidate.
mnemonic.reading: COKE, HO (こうほ)! The candidate hands out free Coke.

examples.ja: 彼は次の社長の候補だ。
examples.en: He's a candidate for the next president.

items.note: Also options: 候補地 (candidate site).

mnemonic.meaning: 冷 is cold: it gets cold by itself. To cool down, to lose interest.
mnemonic.reading: SAME RUE (さめる): the same soup, now cold. You lose interest.

examples.ja: スープが冷めてしまった。
examples.en: The soup has gone cold.

items.note: Intransitive (it cools). 冷ます = you cool it. 覚める (also さめる) = to wake up.

mnemonic.meaning: Pass (通り) and exceed (過ぎる): you go past it. To pass by.
mnemonic.reading: TOE-REE, SUE GEAR-RUE (とおりすぎる): Sue's toe gets caught in a gear as she passes by.

examples.ja: バスが止まらずに通り過ぎた。
examples.en: The bus went past without stopping.

items.note: Often "go past without stopping".

mnemonic.meaning: 雷 is 雨 (rain) over 田 (field): a storm over the field. Thunder.
mnemonic.reading: KAMI NARI (かみなり): "the god (神) is ringing (鳴り)". Thunder!

examples.ja: 夜中に雷が鳴った。
examples.en: Thunder rumbled in the middle of the night.

items.note: 雷が落ちる = lightning strikes. Also a scolding: 雷を落とす.

mnemonic.meaning: The flavour (味) of the ground (地): earthy. Plain, subdued.
mnemonic.reading: JIMMY (じみ) wears plain gray clothes. Simple.

examples.ja: 彼女はいつも地味な服を着ている。
examples.en: She always wears plain clothes.

items.note: Opposite: 派手 (はで, flashy). Not negative in itself; can mean modest.

mnemonic.meaning: The middle (中) study (学). Middle school, junior high.
mnemonic.reading: CHEW, GUCK (ちゅうがく): in middle school you chew gum and leave guck everywhere.

examples.ja: 中学のときはテニス部だった。
examples.en: In junior high, I was in the tennis club.

items.note: Short for 中学校. 中学生 = junior high student.

mnemonic.meaning: 負 is lose: a defeat.
mnemonic.reading: MA, KAY (まけ)! Mom says okay, it's a defeat.

examples.ja: 今回は私の負けだ。
examples.en: I lose this time.

items.note: Noun from 負ける. 勝ち = win. 負けず嫌い = hates to lose.

mnemonic.meaning: The school (校) building (舎).
mnemonic.reading: COACH SHA (こうしゃ): the coach walks into the school building.

examples.ja: 古い校舎が取り壊された。
examples.en: The old school building was torn down.

items.note: Just the building, not the school as an institution.

mnemonic.meaning: How long (長) your body (身) is. Your height.
mnemonic.reading: SHIN, CHOW (しんちょう): eat chow to grow your shin. Height!

examples.ja: 身長は何センチですか。
examples.en: How tall are you (in centimetres)?

items.note: Only for people. 高さ is the height of things.

mnemonic.meaning: 塔 has 土 (earth): earth piled up high. A tower.
mnemonic.reading: TOE (とう): you stand on your toe at the top of the tower.

examples.ja: 寺には五重の塔がある。
examples.en: The temple has a five-storey pagoda.

items.note: 東京タワー uses タワー, but old towers and pagodas are 塔.
